scoringEvidence.decision: Retain all six scores. The review offers weak qualitative support for turnability/forgiveness, park pop and landing, and the intended powder setup, but its season, size and conditions are unknown and its bindings may influence ride feel. No outside score is mapped numerically into the site's six dimensions. Value 8.4 remains especially uncertain because the seed is a GBP-to-CNY-normalized UK price rather than verified China retail data.
scoringEvidence.confidence: Low for all six dimensions; value is very low confidence. Official marketing descriptions and the single undisclosed-version review do not constitute target-season controlled ride testing.
